title: Account
subtitle: Identity and Minecraft linking.
session_desc: The panel itself holds no credentials — every request rides your existing session cookie, whether issued by a passkey / email sign-in or the platform's identity proxy (Zero-Trust / Access).
linked_desc: Linked sessions can claim and own servers — ownership operations (claim, wake, stop) are unblocked.
step1_desc_suffix: in chat. The server already knows your verified identity, so it hands you a one-time code (valid about 10 minutes).
email_desc: Verify your email address to secure your account.
email_step1_desc: Enter the email address you want to bind to request a verification code.
email_step2_desc: Enter the 6-digit verification code sent to your email (valid for 10 minutes).
passkeys_desc: Passkeys let you log in securely using your fingerprint, face, or screen lock PIN.
migration_desc: Move everything a retired account owns onto this one. Migration starts in-game and finishes here.
migration_none_prefix: No migration in progress. To move this account's servers to another account, run
migration_none_suffix: in-game on the account being retired.
migration_confirm_desc: Migration retires this account, so it needs a step-up check first.
migration_confirm_otp_btn: Send a code to my email
migration_issue_desc: Paste the Account ID shown on the destination account's own page here, then issue a one-time transfer code.
migration_code_desc: Sign in as the destination account and redeem this code there before it expires
migration_code_pending: A transfer code has been issued. Redeem it from the destination account before it expires
migration_redeem_desc: Received a code from an account being retired? Redeem it here to take over its servers.
migration_redeemed: Migration complete — {{count}} server(s) moved to this account.
